senses.en_definition: Late; after the expected, scheduled, or appropriate time.
To pass by someone or somewhere.

collocations.en: pass in front of the house

senses.en_definition: Far advanced in time or age, especially late at night or old in years.
Through; by means of a particular medium or method.

messages.en: Where are you now? We're already at the restaurant.
I'll be a bit late. Traffic's really bad right now. Probably another ten minutes or so.
No worries, we'll wait. Want me to order you a drink first?
That feral cat's back behind my house again.
I saw it earlier. It's just sitting under the tree.

senses.en_definition: To look at or watch something.
To see; to have the ability to perceive things by sight.
To examine or assess; to understand or form a judgment through observation.
To tell someone's fortune or predict their fate.
To visit someone, especially someone who is ill.

messages.en: Take a good look at this photo. Can you see the rainbow behind the boat?
Oh, I only just noticed it! It's beautiful. Did you take it in Langkawi?

senses.en_definition: Look; used to draw someone's attention to something or invite them to consider a fact.

collocations.en: take a look at this picture

messages.en: Look at Oyen 😂 I'm trying to get some work done, and he's sleeping on my laptop.
Hahaha, he's telling you to take a break. Look at his little face—he's out like a light!
